LanguageData.CC_Fealty_Ans_Yes_2: {PEOPLE} will take the colony's oath ({WORD}). Someone of theirs is coming to the gate for it: {RITE}, by their ways.
LanguageData.CC_Fealty_Ans_No_2: {PEOPLE} answer that they will not take the colony under their protection. They have their own borders to hold.
LanguageData.CC_Fealty_Ans_No_3: {PEOPLE} turn the colony's oath down. They do not think it would be worth the trouble to them.
LanguageData.CC_Fealty_Offer_2: {WHO} writes for {PEOPLE}: a colony raided twice in one season needs a stronger friend, and they offer to be that friend for its oath. They call it {RITE}; the colony would call it {WORD}.
LanguageData.CC_Fealty_Lord_Comes_2: {LORD} has come from {PEOPLE} to hear the colony's oath at the gate: {RITE}.
LanguageData.CC_Fealty_Lord_Sent_2: {PEOPLE} have sent {LORD} to the gate to take the colony's oath: {RITE}.
LanguageData.CC_Fealty_Sworn_2: At the gate {PAWN} gave the colony's oath to {PEOPLE}, and {LORD} took it: {WORD} to the colony, {RITE} to them.
LanguageData.CC_Fealty_Sworn_3: The oath is sworn. {PAWN} spoke for the colony and {LORD} for {PEOPLE}: {WORD}, by the colony's reckoning, {RITE} by theirs.
LanguageData.CC_Fealty_Protect_Coming_2: {ENEMY} are on the colony's land, and {PEOPLE} have heard: their band is on its way, as the oath promises ({WORD}).
LanguageData.CC_Fealty_Failed_2: {PEOPLE} could not answer this time: no band of theirs will come against {ENEMY}. The oath stands ({WORD}), but this season the colony may leave it without blame.
LanguageData.CC_Fealty_Band_2: The band of {PEOPLE} has come to keep their side of the oath ({WORD}). {COUNT} of them are on the colony's land, making for {ENEMY}.
LanguageData.CC_Fealty_Band_Late_2: Fighters of {PEOPLE} came over the hill after the fight was over. They saw the colony was safe and went home.
LanguageData.CC_Fealty_Paid_2: Their collector came to the gate, and the colony's tribute for {PEOPLE} went out to them: {GOODS}.
LanguageData.CC_Fealty_Paid_3: The season turns, and the tribute for {PEOPLE} is carried out to their collector: {GOODS}.
LanguageData.CC_Fealty_Short_2: {PEOPLE} asked {VALUE} silver's worth for the season, and the colony could give {PAID}. It owes them {OWED}. Unpaid when their collector comes again, the oath is broken ({WORD}).
LanguageData.CC_Fealty_BrokenTribute_2: {PEOPLE} waited a season for the {OWED} silver's worth the colony owed them, and it never came. They hold the oath broken ({WORD}), think {GOODWILL} worse of the colony, and will remember it.
LanguageData.CC_Fealty_Renounced_2: Word has gone to {PEOPLE}: the colony renounces its oath ({WORD}). They will remember it as a wrong done them, {GOODWILL} goodwill and a grudge.
LanguageData.CC_Fealty_Renounced_Clean_2: Word has gone to {PEOPLE}: the colony renounces its oath ({WORD}). They left it to its raiders this season, and have nothing to say against it.
LanguageData.CC_Arms_Fealty_2: {ENEMY} are at {TOWN}, and {WHO} of {PEOPLE} calls on the colony's oath: {RITE}.
LanguageData.CC_Vassal_Harvest_2: A cart has come up from {TOWN} with the colony's share of the harvest ({LEVEL}): {GOODS}.
LanguageData.CC_Vassal_Taken_2: {TOWN} of {PEOPLE} is the colony's to protect from today: {WORD}. It will send produce at harvest, and look to the colony when times are hard.
LanguageData.CC_Vassal_Msg_Called_2: Word goes to {TOWN} by {MEANS}: the colony calls its levies, {RITE}.
LanguageData.CC_Vassal_Band_2: The levies of {PEOPLE} have answered the colony's call: {COUNT} of them, making for {ENEMY} ({WORD}).
LanguageData.CC_Vassal_Ask_Help_2: {WHO} of {TOWN} writes that their stores will not last the season, and asks the colony for {OTHER}.
LanguageData.CC_Vassal_Ask_Judgement_2: {WHO} of {TOWN} writes about their neighbors at {OTHER}: a dispute over water and a field, and they want the colony to settle it.
LanguageData.CC_Vassal_Ask_Camp_2: {WHO} of {TOWN} writes that {OTHER} are camped near them, and asks what the colony means to do about it.
LanguageData.CC_Vassal_Ask_Release_2: {WHO} of {TOWN} writes plainly: their people want to be free of the colony, and ask it to let them go.
LanguageData.CC_Vassal_Ask_Protection_2: {WHO} of {TOWN} writes that the town can't hold on alone, and asks the colony to take it under its protection.
LanguageData.CC_Vassal_Released_2: {TOWN} is free of the colony's protection, as it asked. It goes on as a town of {PEOPLE}, and its head is grateful.
LanguageData.CC_Vassal_BrokeAway_2: {TOWN} asked to be released, was refused, and has gone its own way regardless. The tie is broken, and {PEOPLE} think {GOODWILL} worse of the colony.
